text:
Priya: Big shoutout to @Ethan and @Lina for swooping in on the ACME demo yesterday — stayed after hours, tracked down the env var, and calmed the customer. Absolutely saved the day :tada: :heart:
Ethan: oh wow thanks!! team effort for sure. Lina did the heavy lifting on the config. felt like a 🔧🦸
Lina: not gonna lie, coffee and bagels were the real MVPs ☕🥯. Thanks @Priya for coordinating the quick rollback plan.
Jamal: Seriously impressive. Ops team — can we get a short note in #customer-updates so leadership sees this? :eyes:
Sophia: dropping a :clap: from product. That calm concision in the post-demo notes was gold. +1 on bagels next time pls
Carlos: Can we do a tiny recognition ritual? I threw a few kudos stickers on our whiteboard and put a mini cookie box in the kitchen labeled "demo heroes" :cookie:
Zoe: Also adding to this — @Ethan ran the postmortem doc and it has a clear action item to avoid the env var mismatch. Priya, could you ping the docs team to fold that into the runbook? :memo:
Priya: yup I pinged docs and tagged @Zoe earlier — they said they'll add a short checklist. Thanks for leading followups, Ethan.
Ethan: happy to. Wrote up a 3-line checklist:
```
- verify STAGING_ENV matches deploy config
- run quick smoke script: `curl /health`
- confirm demo creds rotate weekly
```
Lina: also wanna call out @ops-bot — your alert routing pinged Jamal and me within 30s. Felt way less chaotic because of it :robot_face:
ops-bot: incident routed to oncall: Jamal, Lina. Acknowledged by Jamal at 2024-09-15T20:12:03Z. :white_check_mark:
Jamal: LOL ops-bot taking bows now. But legit — automation saved us time.
Sophia: Can we do a micro reward for this cycle? Something low-effort but visible — maybe a rotating "hero mug"? I can front it.
Carlos: I'm in. Whoever gets the mug also gets a free coffee from the pod for a week. Vote with emoji :+1: for yes :smile:
Priya: :+1: :+1: :tada:
Lina: :raised_hands:
Ethan: :coffee:
Zoe: :heart:
Jamal: Thanks everyone. Feels nice to have a chain of small thanks instead of a huge email. Makes the wins sticky.
Priya: agreed. thanks again @Ethan @Lina — big love from product + sales. Next time someone brings bagels I'll nominate you for the mug :grin:
Carlos: tagged a tiny gif in #random — "assembly line of bagels". Worth a look. :framed_picture:
Zoe: Also adding this thread to our monthly kudos roundup doc. If anyone has a one-liner to include, DM me.
Ethan: one-liner incoming: "Ops + product teamwork + late-night bagels = demo success" :mic_drop:
Priya: perfect. Closing the loop — official THANK YOU to the rescue crew. :sparkles:
